models_evaluated: multi-agent LLM system (extractor agent and scorer agent) with automated CNN-based tumor segmentation

links.outcome: BT-RADS classification accuracy versus expert reference standard, AI system compared with initial clinical assessments
links.effect: AI system 374/492 (76.0%; 95% CI 72.1%-79.6%) versus 283/492 (57.5%; 95% CI 53.1%-61.8%) for initial clinical assessments, +18.5 percentage points, P<.001
links.quote: The system achieved 374/492 (76.0%; 95% CI, 72.1%-79.6%) accuracy versus 283/492 (57.5%; 95% CI, 53.1%-61.8%) for initial clinical assessments (+18.5 percentage points; P<.001).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a novel multi-agent LLM and CNN system for automated BT-RADS brain tumor scoring against expert reference standards.
